description: Default reviewed baseline and sole active cohort: DSH 0.2.2-rc.2 with Cordis 4.1.0. Admission is DSH >=0.2.2-rc.2 with no upper bound (floor raised in Guard 0.13.1); compatible newer graphs require registry-acquired qualification, and 0.2.2-rc.1 and earlier hosts refuse at the version gate. The 0.2.2-rc.2 cohort keeps the audited 51-package set at rc.2 versions after real interface changes (session batch event append, tool error identity, working-directory access waterfall, sandbox-policy session grants, jobs error codes, plugin-manager update flows); every tarball was re-verified against the registry. The historical cohorts below record their recorded identities — 0.2.2-rc.1 is the retained upgrade source and refusal control, and rc.5/rc.3/rc.2 are earlier evidence; none of them admit.
